message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18, 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000–30,000 total casualties**—including killed, wounded, missing, and captured. Estimates vary slightly depending on the source:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allies (Napoleon’s forces) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition (Wellington & Blücher) | ~22,000 |

These figures encompass all categories of loss (killed, wounded, missing, and prisoners) and reflect the heavy toll the battle exacted on both sides.
